continuity: The v2 security corpus read the same published matrix on 2026-08-10 and recorded eleven codes with nine authorable. Today's reading returns the same eleven, so the vocabulary is unchanged; this snapshot is nonetheless taken fresh rather than inherited, because a frozen input should be evidenced by a reading of its own.
exclusion_reason: CORPUS_MATCH and STATISTICAL_ANOMALY describe how the scanner reached a detection, not anything an attacker writes. No hand-authored payload can carry them as ground truth, so admitting them to the label vocabulary would let a mechanism code be scored as an attack class. An emission of either is a decision-level event and never a class match.
